business_problem: Syndigo needed a scalable digital platform to help it manage and syndicate data, simplify infrastructure, and become the foundation for its cloud-native technology stack.
solution_summary: Syndigo modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. Syndigo now uses multiple Azure products, like Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), to meet its business needs.

solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale data and runs analytical or machine-learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.
